Now for callTool:

```js
export async function callTool(name, args = {}) {
  if (name !== 'catalog_search') {
    throw new Error('Unknown tool: ' + name);
  }
  // validate args
  const { query, offset = 0, limit = 2 } = args;
  // check extra props
  const allowed = new Set(['query', 'offset', 'limit']);
  for (const key of Object.keys(args)) {
    if (!allowed.has(key)) {
      throw new Error('Unexpected argument: ' + key);
    }
  }
  if (typeof query !== 'string') {
    throw new Error('query must be a string');
  }
  if (!Number.isInteger(offset) || offset < 0) {
    throw new Error('offset must be a non-negative integer');
  }
  if (!Number.isInteger(limit) || limit < 1 || limit > 5) {
    throw new Error('limit must be an integer between 1 and 5');
  }
  
  const matches = items.filter(it => it.name.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()));
  const slice = matches.slice(offset, offset + limit);
  const result = { items: slice };
  if (offset + limit < matches.length) {
    result.next_offset = offset + limit;
  }
  return { content: [{ type: 'text', text: JSON.stringify(result) }] };
}
```
